name: Gästehaus Bergland
beschreibung:
Located in the highest village of the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena, Gaestehaus Bergland in Berwang welcomes guests with cosy, peaceful rooms. The pristine alpine setting invites true relaxation.

Cable cars, cross-country trails, and panoramic hiking tracks start practically outside the front door.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Bergland in Berwang provides restful holidays amidst the peaks of the Zugspitz Arena.
